frozen_initial_rules: A region type is descriptive evidence, never cleanup or suppression authorization by itself.
Kana-only length is not policy authority: every classifier SFX remains review unless an explicit per-region user override selects preserve or replace.
Preserve and review keep source pixels and never enter translation targets, retry queues, per-region translation QA, automatic cleanup, or automatic replacement-object creation.
Explain is note-only and follows the same no-erasure/no-automatic-object rule.
Only replace can enter automatic translation/cleanup/object creation; an explicit valid user override wins for that region only.
Missing classifier evidence or any uncertainty resolves to review, not replace or preserve.
decision: The current narrow classifier is precise but has 15.09% preserve-SFX recall. D02 must use its SFX result only to select source-preserving review, never automatic suppression; policy override supplies intentional preserve/replace decisions.
